record_title: QEACom membership is PSPACE-complete even for neutral-letter NFAs
provenance: Scientific sources, proofs, originality evidence, and finite verification evidence are documented in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Generic aperiodicity/star-freeness complexity and commutative star-free structure are prior work. The result concerns QEACom membership for NFA input, not all O(log n)-circuit regular languages or other automaton representations. Circuit lower bounds inherited from the source use Hardy--Littlewood Omega, not standard eventual Omega. The motivating QEACom paper is recent, leaving residual near-simultaneous originality risk. No independent validation is asserted.
